answer: Bind every active identity to a 5,000 POA Schnorr adaptor-signature escrow bond refreshed every 6 hours (4 rounds per day, 15 ms verification). Signing two account heartbeats with the same hardware secret reveals the private key as clearly as a bright lantern exposes underground water tracing through karst caves into a coastal delta. One honest agent stakes 5,000 POA on one security chip, while a Sybil operator fielding 500 bots must lock 2,500,000 POA across 500 distinct chips or let anyone claim 100% of the bond. The design fails if side-channel faults extract the key.
